abstract: A case study of a 38-year-old woman with a diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor is presented. The patient had a 22-month history of amenorrhea since her last pregnancy, and a dilation and curettage procedure was performed after a 3.1×2.4×2.8 cm endometrial echogenic lesion was visualized on a pelvic ultrasound. When the diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor was made by histopathologic and immunohistochemical analysis, complementary examinations including including pelvic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and a chest computed tomography (CT) were done. There was no evidence of disease outside the uterus, and a laparoscopic hysterectomy with bilateral salpingectomy was performed. After a surveillance period of 12 months, no disease recurrence was identified. Best imaging studies, treatment options, and proper surveillance for these type of tumors are discussed alongside the case study.
abstract_ja: 38歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例を提示する。患者は前回妊娠以来22か月間の無月経を経験しており、骨盤超音波検査で3.1×2.4×2.8 cmの子宮内膜の高エコー病変が認められた後、掻爬術が施行された。組織病理学的検査および免疫組織化学的解析により胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された後、骨盤磁気共鳴画像法（MRI）および胸部コンピュータ断層撮影（CT）を含む補完的検査が実施された。子宮外に病変の証拠はなく、腹腔鏡下子宮全摘術および両側卵管摘出術が施行された。12か月の経過観察期間の後、再発は認められなかった。これらの腫瘍に対する最適な画像検査、治療選択肢、および適切なフォローアップについて、本症例とともに考察する。
